AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Framed Suspended Garden and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce 8 4.4 Making Homemade Soap 8 Total Number of Lesson and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Making Homemade Soap 8 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested number of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
